review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for Qualys VMDR API v4.0, including gateway server and JWT authentication, while retaining backward compatibility with v2.0.
review.reason: The chunk implements a bounded, substantive capability: adding configuration and migration support for a new warehouse connector version (Qualys VMDR v4.0) with backward compatibility. P1.F4.H1 adds the gateway_server configuration field; P1.F2.H1 adds a migration to prevent silent version upgrades; P1.F6 and P1.F7 hunks establish version constants and JWT authentication support. P
